name: browser-workflow-bridge
description: Runs your Browser Workflow automations in your own Chrome and keeps their results on your computer, and connects Claude to the Browser Workflow server. The bridge holds no workflow logic: it carries out the server's browser commands in tabs it opens.

token.title: Bridge token
token.description: Links this bridge to your Browser Workflow account. Ask Claude to "show my browser-workflow account" and click "New bridge token".

server_url.title: Server
server_url.description: The Browser Workflow server's address. Leave it unless you run your own server.

allowed_sites.title: Allowed sites
allowed_sites.description: Only let workflows open these sites, separated by commas (for example: example.com, shop.example.org). * allows any site.

data_dir.title: Data folder
data_dir.description: Where your runs are saved on this computer: screenshots, page HTML and extracted data. Leave empty for ~/.browser-workflow.
